躍らす: to stir (one's feelings); to get excited; to make (one's heart) pound; to make (one's heart) leap
ぱあ: disappearing completely; coming to nought; becoming worthless; losing everything
寸前: just before; on the verge of; on the brink of
食い付く: to jump at (e.g. an offer); to snap at; to get one's teeth into; to really get into
出会う: to meet (by chance); to come across; to run across; to encounter
遣り過ごす: to let (something or someone) go past
振るう: to swing; to wield (physically); to exert
ぶっつけ: without preparation; off the cuff; abrupt; without warning
本番: performance (as opposed to practice); going before an audience or on-air; take

__flags__.躍らす: 踊らし = 踊る (to dance) +したる, not 躍らす 'stir feelings'
__flags__.あない: あない = Kansai 'あんな' (that kind of), not 案内
__flags__.台: うてな in 意味やのうてな = やのうて+な (not so), not 台
__flags__.稚児: ちごたかも = 違ったかも (differed), not 稚児
__flags__.飛ぶ: 飛んできて = rush over; sense fits 'hurry' but is a compound-verb use
__flags__.ぱあ: パーっと is an adverbial mimetic (with a bang), not the noun senses
__flags__.ぶっつけ: part of set phrase ぶっつけ本番 (winging it)
